en: someone whose job is to teach in a school or college
the long part at each side of the human body, ending in a hand
the whole physical structure that forms a person or animal
ex: Where on your body is your head?

zh: 耳朵；灵敏的听力；倾听；穗；耳状物
en: one of the two organs on your head that you hear with
ex: She's got an earring in her right ear.

en: one of the two organs in your face that you use to see with
the front part of the head, where the eyes, nose and mouth are
ex: She's got a long, thin face.

zh: 脚，足；英尺；基础，底部；袜底；音步；<文>步态，步伐；（缝纫机的）压脚板
en: one of the two flat parts on the ends of your legs that you stand on
ex: I hurt my left foot playing football.

en: one of the two parts on the ends of your arms that have fingers and a thumb
one of the parts of the body of a human or animal that is used for standing and walking
ex: The dog has got short legs.

en: the part of the face that is used for eating and speaking

zh: 鼻子；（飞机、火箭等的）头部，机首；嗅觉；觉察力；（酒的）特有的气味；<非正式>警方线人；探听，探问
en: the part of your face through which you breathe and smell
the colour of the sky without clouds on a bright day

zh: 灰色，灰色颜料；灰色衣服；灰白头发；灰马，白马
en: the colour that is a mixture of black and white
ex: The waiter has got grey hair.

en: having a large distance from one end to the other
ex: She’s tall and she’s got long black hair.

zh: （头发）卷曲的，鬈曲的；弧形的，螺旋形的；（木材）有皱状纹理的
en: having curls or a curved shape
small in length
the colour of the sky on a dark night
ex: She’s tall and she’s got long black hair.

zh: 金黄色的，浅棕色的；金发的；浅色的
en: describes hair which is a pale yellow colour
describes hair which is an orange-brown colour

zh: 褐色的，棕色的；肤色深的，晒黑的；未去壳的，糙的
en: the colour of chocolate or soil

zh: （头发）鬈曲的；波纹状的，波浪形的；（纹章）波形的，波状的
en: with slight curves
not curved or bent
the colour of grass

zh: 胡须，络腮胡子；（动物的）颔毛，须；（植物的）芒，髯毛；替身；<非正式>名义女伴
en: the hair that grows on a man's chin
a piece of jewellery that you wear on your ear
ex: She's got an earring in her right ear.

zh: 眼镜；玻璃杯（glass 的复数）；双筒望远镜（尤见于 field glasses）
en: a piece of equipment with two transparent parts that you wear in front of your eyes to help you see better

zh: 髭，小胡子；长髭；（动物嘴部周围的）须状物
en: a line of hair that some men grow above their mouths
small in height
ex: She's quite tall, she's not short.

zh: 微笑；微笑着说，以微笑表示；现出（笑容）；觉得好笑，觉得高兴；惠及，赞许
en: a happy or friendly expression in which the corners of your mouth curve up
ex: She's got a very nice smile.

zh: 高的，高大的；（用于指高度）有……高的，身高……的；过分的，夸大的；（饮料）含少量酒精的
en: having a greater than average height
ex: She's quite tall, she's not short.
